items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: I considered him a true friend, a real gentleman.

ctx.x: So all of this, of course, is affecting his business.

Yes. I'm assuming so. Yes. Well, when he got to really drinking and gambling bed, he would never admit it. But it was part of the problem, the latter-day problems of A1. You know, he was losing a fair amount of money at the track. And by going to the track instead of being at A1, he was losing in other ways. And we talked about it from time to time. I considered him a true friend, a real gentleman.
